summary: Healthcare workers in low-resource settings benefit from secure, offline-capable, data-driven solutions enabled by the Android FHIR SDK. This open-source component accelerates the adoption of modern healthcare standards, particularly in global health contexts. The SDK facilitates the use of the HL7 FHIR standard in mobile applications, promoting interoperability and structured data capture. Its primary goal is to support the development of next-gen digital health apps, ultimately improving healthcare outcomes in underserved areas. The SDK's offline-first capability is particularly valuable in low-resource settings where internet connectivity is limited. By making it easier to adopt modern healthcare standards, the Android FHIR SDK contributes to more efficient and effective healthcare delivery.
